description: load_tool, the harness tool that loads one catalogued tool's schema (ADR-0006): its declaration as the boundary offers it, where the schema budget made any source a catalogue. Written by hand; toolSources.test.ts holds SourceGate.loadTool to it, and go/context its Go form.

items.name: load_tool
items.description: Load the input schema of one catalogued tool before calling it. Pass its name as the tools list shows it; only a catalogued tool's schema loads. A loaded schema stays in the execution state for the rest of this response.

name.description: The catalogued tool's name, as the tools list shows it.
